summary: Ingest a manifest-bound object set with identity and digest validation, quarantine, atomic staging, replay accounting, and rollback evidence.
triggers: A supplied manifest defines the exact objects to ingest.
Accepted, rejected, quarantined, and conflicting objects need a replayable ledger.
Storage writes must be checked before and after commit.
antiTriggers: Crawl paths outside the authorized manifest.
Overwrite a collision before identity and rollback checks pass.
Delete source objects as an implicit part of ingestion.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Manifest, integrity, quarantine, replay, and rollback semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no ingestion or source-quality result is asserted.
